title: Urban Design Consultants/Multi Discipline Team for Placemaking Plans - Adamsdown & Splott
description: Cardiff Council has appointed an experienced, urban design-led multidisciplinary consultancy team to prepare a comprehensive Placemaking Plan for Adamsdown and Splott. The commission will establish a long-term, place-based vision and delivery framework to guide coordinated regeneration, investment, public realm improvements, sustainable transport interventions, environmental enhancements, climate resilience measures and community development across the study area.
